parameters.note: Rubicon Lake, an alpine lake in the Desolation Wilderness (El Dorado Co.) high on the Meeks Creek chain above Stony Ridge Lake, is not listed in CCR §7.40(b) or §7.50(b). The §7.50(b)(152) Lake Tahoe tributary special regulation by its terms covers Tahoe tributary streams 'upstream to the first lake' and the lake within 300 ft of tributary mouths — not standing lakes above the first lake — so it does not reach Rubicon Lake. The lake therefore falls under the general statewide lake regulation §5.85(a)(1).

candidates.summary: Open all year (general statewide lake regulation; not listed as a special-regulation water)

parameters.description: Rubicon Lake lies within the Desolation Wilderness (Eldorado National Forest / Lake Tahoe Basin Management Unit). A wilderness permit is required to enter: a free day-use permit (self-issued at major trailheads, no fee and not quota-limited) and, for overnight trips, an overnight permit required year-round. Overnight use is governed by a zone-quota system in effect from the Friday before Memorial Day through September 30 each year; overnight permits and reservations are handled through Recreation.gov (permit #233261).

raw.day_use_permit: required; free; no fee; not quota-limited
raw.overnight_quota_season: Friday before Memorial Day through September 30
